subject: Operational readiness: Ridgeway Labs go-live checklist & owner ladder
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jill Tan <jill.tan@ridgewaylabs.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Operational readiness: Ridgeway Labs go-live checklist & owner ladder

Hi all —

Quick pass to hand this across to CS. Ridgeway signed on last week; they want a pilot go-live for a narrow set of intents by June 14. High-level facts below and a couple of asks for CS to pick owners and dates:

Why this matters
- Pilot is customer-facing search/chat for clinical guidelines — high visibility at Ridgeway leadership
- Committed 50k tokens/day to start, likely to scale if SLA/latency targets met

What we've completed (Sales)
- PO received and countersigned SOW (see attached SOW_v2_redlines.pdf)
- Shared initial API keys in staging and seeded two prompt families
- Agreed activation target: 2027-06-14 pilot launch

Open items for CS
1) Primary implementation lead (owner for MLP and acceptance testing) — request nomination by EOD Friday
2) Data/PII review: Ridgeway confirmed only de-identified logs to be pushed to hosted analytics; verify retention settings and log routing
3) Runbook: confirm who will own runbook and quick rollback plan for first 72 hours
4) SRE contact and escalation ladder — they want a named on-call during pilot window

Attachments: Ridgeway_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (mutual action plan draft), SOW_v2_redlines.pdf

Next steps (proposed)
- Marissa: propose a 30-min kickoff with Ridgeway + internal implementers next Tue (5/31) or Wed (6/1) — can you confirm availability?
- Ben: can you validate capacity for a 2-week heavy-ops window starting 6/10?

Jill — feel free to add anything I missed. I can join kickoff for the first 15 minutes.

Thanks,
Mateo
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Mateo Alvarez
T: (415) 555-0123 | mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
From: Jill Tan <jill.tan@ridgewaylabs.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational readiness: Ridgeway Labs go-live checklist & owner ladder

Thanks, Mateo — and great summary. A few clarifications from Ridgeway side:

- Acceptance criteria: 90% intent match on the core guideline set (we'll send the test prompts).
- Data handling: we will push only de-identified telemetry to the hosted analytics bucket; sensitive docs will stay on-prem in S3 behind our VPC.
- Weekly alignment cadence OK — prefer Tue mornings PT.

For the kickoff, our team can do 5/31 AM PT. Attendees from Ridgeway: myself (owner), Priya Desai (engineering lead), Mark O'Connell (compliance).

Also attaching the internal compliance checklist they asked us to review — will upload to the Drive folder after this thread.

Best,
Jill
Director of Product | Ridgeway Labs
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jill Tan <jill.tan@ridgewaylabs.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational readiness: Ridgeway Labs go-live checklist & owner ladder

Thanks for the handoff, Mateo — happy to take point on this. Quick internal plan and owner ladder below.

Owner ladder (proposed)
- Primary implementation lead: Marissa Cole (owns kickoff, runbook, acceptance)
- Technical integration: Ben Carter (SRE/ops lead — deploy/scale/rollbacks)
- Compliance & retention: Monica Patel (security review & retention config) — cc'ing out-of-thread for coordination
- Customer success sponsor: Mateo Alvarez (commercial touchpoint during pilot)

Immediate asks for internal prep (this week)
- Ben: confirm that staging instance can mirror their VPC connectivity for SFTP pull (doc in Drive).
- Ben: validate we can set retention to 30 days for pilot logs and create a separate analytics bucket per account.
- Marissa: I will draft a 15-point acceptance checklist and share before EOD Friday; please flag anything missing.

Proposed kickoff times: 5/31 09:30 PT (preferred) or 6/1 09:00 PT. I'll send a calendar invite once times confirmed.

Attachments referenced: Ridgeway_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (I updated task owners column)

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Operational readiness: Ridgeway Labs go-live checklist & owner ladder

Ack — Ben here.
- Staging can support VPC-style connectivity for SFTP pull; I'll validate exact IP ranges and post to the Drive doc by EOD.
- Retention: can create a separate analytics bucket and set lifecycle to 30 days. Will also add a permission audit entry for Ridgeway Admin.
- Capacity: confirm we have the reserved pool for the pilot window (6/10-6/18); I will flag any conflicts if they appear.

I'll send the IP ranges + brief ops runbook fragment as a Drive link when ready.
